explanation: Mathlib has `Nat.factorization_ordCompl : (ordCompl[p] n).factorization = n.factorization.erase p` (Mathlib/Data/Nat/Factorization/Basic.lean). It has no matching statement for `primeFactors`. Getting the theorem from it takes `support_factorization` (used twice) and `Finsupp.support_erase` as well, so it is not a single-declaration specialization. I grepped Mathlib for every use of `ordCompl`, for `primeFactors` together with `erase`, and for `primeFactors_div*`. None of these turned up a statement about `(ordCompl[p] n).primeFactors`.
